q1_issues.issue: (Future sk_begin_1) is asserted although the item supplies no TODAY and the adjunct 'in September' is not lexically future, and the Time section names this exact sentence ('the harvest begins in September', no TODAY) as the case that must emit no tense atom at all.

q2_gaps: aspectual begin/start whose subject IS the eventuality, with no 'to V' complement ('the apple harvest begins'): the Inception section only schematizes 'X began to V' (subject = Agent or the intransitive-subject role, Theme = a separate activity witness marked Ongoing), so it does not say whether the subject-eventuality takes Theme or the change-of-state Patient, nor whether Ongoing applies when subject and activity collapse into one symbol
notes: The compound handling (apple_harvest with genus harvest, noun modifier 'apple' correctly not exposed) and (Time sk_begin_1 (Month september)) are right; the futurate tense atom is the only defect.
